packageRules.description: Frame's deps ARE its product, so bumps are releasable changes, not chores. release-please ignores `chore`, which would leave bumps merged but never published.
Non-major tooling updates merge themselves once CI is green. No PR is opened unless something fails.
Frame's own internal chain: eslint-plugin -> eslint-config -> dev-deps.
Majors are where configs actually break. This rule is LAST so it overrides the internal-packages rule too — no major ever automerges, including frame's own.
